   771	typedef struct heapframe {
   772	
   773	  /* The first set of fields are variables that have to be preserved over calls
   774	  to RRMATCH(), but which do not need to be copied to new frames. */
   775	
   776	  PCRE2_SPTR ecode;          /* The current position in the pattern */
   777	  PCRE2_SPTR temp_sptr[2];   /* Used for short-term PCRE_SPTR values */
   778	  PCRE2_SIZE length;         /* Used for character, string, or code lengths */
   779	  PCRE2_SIZE back_frame;     /* Amount to subtract on RRETURN */ 
   780	  PCRE2_SIZE temp_size;      /* Used for short-term PCRE2_SIZE values */
   781	  uint32_t rdepth;           /* "Recursion" depth */
   782	  uint32_t group_frame_type; /* Type information for group frames */
   783	  uint32_t temp_32[4];       /* Used for short-term 32-bit or BOOL values */
   784	  uint8_t return_id;         /* Where to go on in internal "return" */
   785	  uint8_t op;                /* Processing opcode */
   786	
   787	#if PCRE2_CODE_UNIT_WIDTH == 8
   788	  PCRE2_UCHAR occu[6];       /* Used for other case code units */
   789	#elif PCRE2_CODE_UNIT_WIDTH == 16
   790	  PCRE2_UCHAR occu[2];       /* Used for other case code units */
   791	#else
   792	  PCRE2_UCHAR occu[1];       /* Used for other case code units */
   793	#endif
   794	
   795	  /* The rest have to be copied from the previous frame whenever a new frame
   796	  becomes current. */
   797	
   798	  PCRE2_SPTR eptr;           /* MUST BE FIRST */
   799	  PCRE2_SPTR start_match;    /* Can be adjusted by \K */
   800	  PCRE2_SPTR mark;           /* Most recent mark on the success path */ 
   801	  uint32_t current_recurse;  /* Current (deepest) recursion number */
   802	  uint32_t capture_last;     /* Most recent capture */
   803	  PCRE2_SIZE last_group_offset;  /* Saved offset to most recent group frame */
   804	  PCRE2_SIZE offset_top;     /* Offset after highest capture */
   805	  PCRE2_SIZE ovector[2];     /* Must be last in the structure */
   806	} heapframe;
   807	
   808	typedef char check_heapframe_size[
   809	  ((sizeof(heapframe) % sizeof(PCRE2_SIZE)) == 0)? (+1):(-1)];
   810	
   811	/* Structure for passing "static" information around between the functions
   812	doing traditional NFA matching (pcre2_match() and friends). */
   813	
   814	typedef struct match_block {
   815	  pcre2_memctl memctl;            /* For general use */
   816	  PCRE2_SIZE frame_vector_size;   /* Size of a backtracking frame */
   817	  heapframe *match_frames;        /* Points to vector of frames */
   818	  heapframe *match_frames_top;    /* Points after the end of the vector */
   819	  heapframe *stack_frames;        /* The original vector on the stack */ 
   820	  PCRE2_SIZE heap_limit;          /* As it says */
   821	  uint32_t match_limit;           /* As it says */
   822	  uint32_t match_limit_depth;     /* As it says */
   823	  uint32_t match_call_count;      /* Number of times a new frame is created */
   824	  BOOL hitend;                    /* Hit the end of the subject at some point */
   825	  BOOL hasthen;                   /* Pattern contains (*THEN) */
